notes.title: ROGUELINE ROADMAP
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who has played ROGUELINE!
I've received a ton of great feedback, and now that the game is in a (mostly) stable state, it's time to break it all with updates!

I've divided all the work planned for ROGUELINE into 3 chunks, the .DOUBLE, .META and finally .LAUNCH.
You can check out the roadmap graphic for more info. You can also follow development and send me suggestions on twitter @KitDavisGames

Thanks All
-KD
